bullets.text: The State government ordered civic agencies to complete flood mitigation work in Chennai and suburbs by October 15.
Residents in the Vadaperumbakkam area near Sengundram in Chennai protested on the road at midnight over power cuts, clashing with police.
Adambakkam MRTS station remains closed for over seven months due to a platform-train gap exceeding safety standards, causing public disappointment.
Bill Gates warned that artificial intelligence poses a potential risk of causing the deaths of one billion people.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power cut in areas including Velachery, Porur, and Besant Nagar for maintenance work.
Drinking water supply has been restored in Adyar and Perungudi zones following the completion of major pipeline relocation work.
GCC Commissioner GS Sameeran inspected drone-based mosquito larvicide spraying along the Cooum River as dengue cases rise.
Two persons drowned in separate incidents along the Tiruvallur and Chennai coasts, including a mason in Pulicat.
A sudden fire broke out at the Tiruttani Murugan temple while lighting ghee lamps, causing a stir.
The Avadi Police Commissionerate conducted a three-day special drive against history-sheeters and anti-social elements.
TIDCO has invited tenders to set up a Rs 400 crore digital financial center in Coimbatore to promote FinTech.
CtrlS Datacenters partnered with Ciena to build five high-capacity metro networks connecting nine data centres across five cities including Chennai.
An IIT Madras study revealed that educated professionals are also falling victim to digital financial frauds due to specific methods.
The TVK government has faced controversy and rolled back several newly announced decisions since taking office.
TVK party flags suddenly appeared on encroached shops along the GNT Road in Gummidipoondi ahead of an anti-encroachment drive.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will share the stage with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Chennai on October 11.
The fare chart for the 14.64-km Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani Phase II Metro stretch was released, ranging from Rs 10 to Rs 40.
The new Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro train service will open for public use starting October 11.
